description: `useCallback(fn, deps)` caches a **function definition** between renders. Equivalent to `useMemo(() => fn, deps)`.
`setState((previous) => next)` reads the latest state at update time, so callbacks do not need state in their dependencies.
Functions returned by `useState` and `useReducer` (`setX`, `dispatch`) never change identity and can be omitted from dependencies.
A cached function that captured old values because a dependency was missing. Leads to updates based on outdated state.
